faqs.q: How much does Qualifacts CareLogic cost?
faqs.a: CareLogic base pricing starts around $50/provider/month, but total cost includes implementation ($5K-50K+), training, and ongoing support. Enterprise deployments with full analytics and integrations cost more. Implementation typically completes in 3-6 months, faster than competitors like myEvolv.

faqs.q: What's the difference between CareLogic and Credible?
faqs.a: Both are Qualifacts products. CareLogic is designed for larger organizations (CMHCs, behavioral health agencies) with complex workflows and state reporting needs. Credible targets smaller practices with simpler needs and lower implementation requirements. CareLogic has more customization but longer setup.

Yes, Qualifacts offers Qualifacts IQ, an AI-powered copilot that integrates with CareLogic. It provides clinical decision support, documentation assistance, and analytics. This is an add-on to the base EHR.

faqs.q: How long does CareLogic implementation take?
faqs.a: CareLogic implementation typically takes 3-6 months, which is faster than Netsmart myEvolv (9-24 months) but longer than private practice EHRs (1-4 weeks). Implementation includes data migration, workflow configuration, training, and go-live support.

faqs.q: What are alternatives to Qualifacts CareLogic?
faqs.a: For enterprise behavioral health: Netsmart myEvolv (larger organizations, longer implementation) or myAvatar. For mid-size agencies: Qualifacts Credible (simpler) or InSync. For addiction treatment: Kipu EMR. For private practices: SimplePractice or TherapyNotes.

one_liner: Enterprise behavioral health EHR for CMHCs with state reporting, care coordination, and AI copilot.
